name: Calulu
subtitle: Calulu is the traditional dish of São Tomé and Príncipe, made with smoked fish or with meat.

facts.label: Type of dish
facts.value: The traditional dish of São Tomé and Príncipe, made with smoked fish or with meat

facts.label: Served with
facts.value: Banana angu (mashed plantain or breadfruit banana), rice, fuba and cassava flour

facts.label: Main ingredients
facts.value: Chicken or fish, chopped okra, onion, tomatoes, palm oil and breadfruit

facts.label: Leaves
facts.value: Several kinds of chopped local leaves, including turtle, otagi, mússua and dot leaves

facts.label: Cooking
facts.value: The pot is simmered for 30 to 45 minutes

parts.text: Calulu is the traditional dish of São Tomé and Príncipe, made with smoked fish or with meat. Chicken or fish is cooked with a mix of chopped local leaves, okra, onion, tomatoes, palm oil and breadfruit.
It is a typical family meal, regarded as a rich delicacy, and is eaten with banana angu (a mash of plantain or breadfruit banana), rice, fuba or cassava flour.
